title: WhatsApp Cloud event filters
description: Configuration for whatsapp::cloud::events. All fields are optional. Fields combine with AND; values within a list combine with OR. Empty or null lists apply no restriction, except kinds, which defaults to incoming messages. The worker also enforces a 64 KiB serialized configuration limit.

kinds.description: Event kinds to receive. Omitted, empty or null means message.received only. Select message.status explicitly for delivery receipts.

chat_ids.description: Conversation identities: international phone numbers or Meta business-scoped user IDs. Phone formatting is normalized to +digits. For status events this is the recipient. Native WhatsApp JIDs, group JIDs and internal cloud: archive IDs are not supported.

sender_ids.description: Sender identities, using the same normalization as chat_ids. Status events have no sender and cannot match a nonempty sender_ids filter.

message_types.description: Exact raw Meta message types, such as text, image, interactive or contacts. Future type names are allowed. Status events have no message type and cannot match a nonempty message_types filter.

statuses.description: Delivery states. Set kinds to include message.status; a status filter does not change the default kind. Incoming messages have no status and cannot match a nonempty statuses filter.

business_account_id.description: Exact Meta WhatsApp Business Account ID. Omitted, empty or null means no account restriction.

phone_number_id.description: Exact Meta Phone Number ID, not the displayed telephone number. Omitted, empty or null means no phone restriction.

identity.description: The worker validates and normalizes this value. International phone numbers must contain 7 to 15 digits, beginning with a nonzero digit; an initial +, spaces, parentheses and hyphens are accepted. Business-scoped user IDs use a two-letter uppercase prefix, a dot, optional ENT., and 1 to 128 letters or digits. Surrounding whitespace is ignored.
